title: Chat keeps the agent's line breaks
head: fix/chat-line-breaks
body:
Braden: agent chat replies looked cluttered, because line breaks were collapsed into one paragraph. His choice: plain text with the line breaks kept, no Markdown rendering and no new dependency.

**Change:** `.chat__message` gets `white-space: pre-wrap` and `overflow-wrap: anywhere`. That's the only UI change.

**Companion change (separate agent-core PR, after T13 PR A):** the chat prompt tells the model to answer in plain text, with no `**`, `#` or backticks.

**Tests:** `tests/chatStyles.test.ts` checks that the base `.chat__message` rule has both properties. I confirmed it fails when `pre-wrap` is removed.

```
npm run typecheck     → pass
eslint src tests      → pass
vitest run            → 13 files, 50 passed
git diff --check      → clean
```
